title: Streaming SSE/WS leak data across personas
description: streaming.rs:86,128-133. The resolve_channel function maps 'public' to the literal channel 'public'. The SSE handler at line 128-133 filters events by channel == resolved. But publish() in inbox.rs:992-997 publishes to channel 'public' for any visibility=='public' post from any remote actor. The streaming user sees all public-timeline events regardless of which persona they authenticated as. For a single-user server this is fine, but if multiple personas are configured, one persona's authenticated streaming client sees events published for all personas' timelines. The 'user:{account_id}' channel is correctly scoped, but the 'public' channel is global.
close_reason: This is correct Mastodon behavior. The public timeline shows all public posts from all users. This is by design in the Mastodon streaming API.
